target_customer: Sports fans who buy athlete tokens and play fantasy games, plus athletes and celebrities who partner with the platform
problem: Fans cannot share in the careers of athletes they follow, and athletes lack ways to monetize their audience directly.
business_model: Tokenization platform selling athlete tokens backed by image rights, plus fantasy game and events

founders.name: Andrea Bonapersona
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked with top football players for years; no education listed.

founders.name: Jean-Joseph Mariani
founders.background_notes: YC page lists legal, consulting and operations experience across Europe.

competitors.name: Socios.com (Chiliz)
competitors.what: Fan token platform for sports clubs
competitors.traction_then: More than 70 clubs launched fan tokens per a later snippet

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a token marketplace and fantasy game on Solana is standard web3 engineering; the hard part was partnerships, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive athlete image rights deals are the only moat; the technology is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent copying the model in a dated way.

market_need_then: Fan tokens and sports NFTs were a visible crypto segment in 2021 and 2022 per the Chiliz and Cointelegraph coverage found, though demand durability was not shown.

branding.domain_note: Company site referenced as en.trendex.vip; domain history not found.

identity.logo: A rebrand case on Contra exists but no description was read

branding.brand_signature: Celebrity athlete partnerships (Benzema, Gobert, Marcus Smart)
branding.community_and_virality: Press about athlete investors such as Rudy Gobert and Karim Benzema exists.

brand_strength.rationale: Athlete names drive attention but no source shows the Trendex brand itself driving growth.

outcome_analysis: Trendex stayed active, signed athlete partners and acquired the Web3 streaming platform Gummys in May 2024 per CB Insights and press listings. It later ran a small crowdfunding raise per Kingscrowd, which suggests limited venture momentum, but funding sources conflict, so the trajectory is not clear.
notes: Funding conflicts and is unverified: Seedtable lists a pre-seed in Apr 2022 and a seed in May 2023, Wefunder snippet says $3.5M raised, another listing says $2.4M seed, Kingscrowd lists a 2025 RegCF SAFE of $96,748 at a $30M valuation, and Crowdability lists Benzema and Gobert as investors. The Wefunder page returned 403 so none could be cross-checked; no rounds recorded. YC page says founded 2021; other profiles say July 2022 and name Nicolas Alfonsi as a co-founder, not recorded as that is not on the YC page. The Socios entry has no dated source. Completeness pass: the pre-seed (2022-04) and seed (2023-05) rest on Seedtable alone with conflicting amounts (about 866K to 1.4M, totals 3.5M to 3.8M elsewhere), so amounts are null. The 2025 Reg CF SAFE of 96,748 rests on Kingscrowd alone.
